outcome: transfer to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
cohort: 3166 neonates born to Pacific Islander mothers and 2101 neonates born to Caucasian mothers
finding: Samoan women have higher rates of macrosomia and lower rates of low birth weight compared to Caucasian women, with macrosomic infants in the Samoan population experiencing higher perinatal mortality and composite severe neonatal morbidity.
birth_weight: Macrosomic (>4500 g) and low birth weight (<2500 g)
